name: EPIC 215138812
description: A red giant in K2 campaign 7, 10.9 solar radii and 0.96 solar masses, weighed by its oscillations.

radius.source: Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_gal, EPIC 215138812 (K2 campaign 7): PARAM radius (solar radii) 10.888648 (16th-84th percentiles 10.474177-11.333212), MA09 pipeline with GALAH DR3

mass.source: Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_gal, EPIC 215138812 (K2 campaign 7): PARAM mass (solar masses) 0.958951 (16th-84th percentiles 0.879403-1.054011), MA09 pipeline with GALAH DR3

temperature.source: Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_gal, EPIC 215138812: GALAH DR3 effective temperature 4981.2373 +/- 198 K (the catalogue's final uncertainty)

distance.source: Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_gal, EPIC 215138812 (K2 campaign 7): PARAM asteroseismic distance (pc) 4727.578125 (16th-84th percentiles 4599.6875-4853.320312), MA09 pipeline with GALAH DR3

color.reason: PARAM fits an extinction A_V = 0.69 mag toward this star (Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_gal, AV-M), and the color routes do not remove extinction; GALAH measured its temperature

text.card: A red giant 4,728 parsecs away, 11 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded in K2 campaign 7, give 0.96 solar masses and 10.9 solar radii; GALAH spectra give 4,981 K at its surface.
